scale: 1 low to 5 high; RPN is triage only and never overrides a severity-5 hazard gate

rows.failureMode: Press-to-arm switch stuck low or mechanically jammed
rows.currentControls: Recessed momentary switch; stuck-low fault; continuous-hold lease
rows.requiredVerification: Switch fault injection and release timing HIL

rows.failureMode: Firmware fails to disarm on release/reset/watchdog
rows.currentControls: Independent raw input; bounded lease; watchdog; safe defaults
rows.requiredVerification: Oscilloscope capture over release/reset/brownout/watchdog

rows.failureMode: Receiver output glitches during boot or brownout
rows.currentControls: Gate pulldown; inactive GPIO initialization; power-good monitor
rows.requiredVerification: Repeated power ramp and reset fault injection at all outputs

rows.failureMode: BLE link loss is not detected in budget
rows.currentControls: Freshness window, arm lease and link watchdog
rows.requiredVerification: RF attenuation/disconnect HIL with output waveform

rows.failureMode: Replay, cross-device or stale-session packet accepted
rows.currentControls: LE Secure Connections plus AES-CCM/session/direction/sequence binding
rows.requiredVerification: Negative vectors, packet capture, reboot/power-loss sequence tests

rows.failureMode: Nonce or monotonic counter reused after power loss
rows.currentControls: Persistent sequence epoch and fail-closed recovery
rows.requiredVerification: Power-cut campaign and storage wear/corruption tests

rows.failureMode: False gesture classification
rows.currentControls: Confidence threshold, rejection class, press-to-arm gating
rows.requiredVerification: Representative-user confusion matrix and false-activation study

rows.failureMode: Relative IMU estimate represented as exact 3D path
rows.currentControls: Explicit no-absolute-position contract
rows.requiredVerification: Requirements/UI/content audit and algorithm review

rows.failureMode: Wrong cell, NTC or charger setting
rows.currentControls: Protected keyed pack; NTC supervision; current/thermal limits
rows.requiredVerification: Ordered-part audit, abuse-aware bench charge and thermal test

rows.failureMode: Haptic/BLE transient collapses 3.3 V rail
rows.effect: Reset, lost safety state or erratic feedback
rows.currentControls: Buck-boost margin and decoupling; brownout-safe logic
rows.requiredVerification: Worst-state transient waveform and hot/cold battery test

rows.failureMode: Antenna detuned by ground, battery, GFRP, hand or enclosure
rows.effect: Intermittent link and delayed safe-state detection
rows.currentControls: Nonconductive end and conservative mechanical keepout
rows.requiredVerification: Final layout overlay and representative RF comparison/pre-scan

rows.failureMode: VREF_IO or connector is miswired
rows.currentControls: Keyed labels, voltage-domain contract and translator direction
rows.requiredVerification: Connector fault injection and voltage sweep

rows.failureMode: Optocoupler CTR insufficient or isolation pins grounded
rows.effect: Output fails or isolation boundary is lost
rows.currentControls: Floating collector/emitter and conservative current target
rows.requiredVerification: Exact-bin review, DRC and min/max temperature load test

rows.failureMode: MOSFET short, copper overheats or flyback omitted
rows.effect: Load remains active or board overheats
rows.currentControls: Gate pulldown, provisional current limit and external flyback
rows.requiredVerification: DRC/current-density review, thermal test and inductive fault test

rows.failureMode: Mains conductor or uncertified relay is brought inside product
rows.currentControls: Hard SELV boundary and external certified enclosed relay only
rows.requiredVerification: Qualified installer design/installation inspection

rows.failureMode: Receiver assigned to arming, propulsion or primary flight control
rows.effect: Loss of vehicle control or injury
rows.currentControls: AUX/telemetry-only contract; no propulsion wiring
rows.requiredVerification: Integrator config audit, ground and restrained-prop failsafe test

rows.failureMode: Shell, rod or adhesive interface fails
rows.effect: Parts detach; antenna stack shifts; impact hazard
rows.currentControls: GFRP insertion and prototype fit definitions
rows.requiredVerification: Material freeze, coupon/pull test, drop/fatigue and first-article inspection

rows.failureMode: Feedback pattern is ambiguous or indicates success on fault
rows.currentControls: Distinct paired/armed/accepted/rejected/fault patterns
rows.requiredVerification: Blinded usability and state-machine fault tests

rows.failureMode: Stale drawing/BOM/firmware revision reaches factory
rows.effect: Wrong product or latent safety defect
rows.currentControls: Hash manifest, revision parity and release locks
rows.requiredVerification: Independent manifest/revision audit at every handoff

rows.failureMode: Unqualified substitute or malformed MPN ordered
rows.currentControls: Exact MPN/footprint review and order-time lifecycle recheck
rows.requiredVerification: Procurement AVL review and incoming inspection
